purpose: Reuse the published TM20 Go2 whole-body iLQG controller to obtain complete rigid-ground out-turn-return-stand missions. First establish author-model execution, then the original project robot and actuator limits. This is a bounded execution baseline, not full-paper reproduction or proof of terrain-memory benefit.

implementation_declarations.necessary_build_flag: libmjpc target is built with -fno-strict-aliasing. The pinned pointer-based integer/double bit reinterpretation otherwise compiled under GCC/LTO into an uninitialized gait stack read and segfaulted in FootStep before any plant step. No optimizer, feedback, gain or cost change.
implementation_declarations.model_transport: Official Agent run_init=False followed by init(send_as='xml'), with absolute on-host mesh paths. The native 50MB MJB exceeds the official agent_server 20MiB receive limit; no server payload-limit patch is applied.
implementation_declarations.author_input_mapping_repair: Pinned task_flat.xml includes go2.xml, whose general actuator declares gainprm=60 and biasprm=0,-60,-5 but omits biastype=affine. The task adapter explicitly enables affine bias in the single model shared by Agent and actual plant. Record the compiled source value and repaired value. No gain, cost or physical-model search is performed.
implementation_declarations.G0_identity: Author native physical model with the declared task and affine-PD input mapping; original unbounded actuator force remains unbounded. This is not an unchanged-XML reproduction.
implementation_declarations.author_prediction_contact_approximation: The retained Agent MakeDifferentiable behavior temporarily sets solimp[0]=0 during gradient planning and restores it afterward. Plant contact settings remain original. This approximation and the 0.01s predictor versus 0.0002s G1 plant step are declared.
implementation_declarations.mission_reference: Original state-based phases and velocity/heading rate limits; integrate the bounded x velocity into a continuous world-route body goal clamped to the original endpoints, keep world y=0, and advance heading continuously at at most 0.5rad/s. Head offset is applied afterward.
implementation_declarations.feedback_action: Official get_action(time=data.time, nominal_action=False, averaging_duration=0), with current actual state synchronized every 0.002s.

frozen_previous.interpretation: The requested interface repairs were implemented but T1R still failed all three rigid development missions. This does not invalidate historical second-round B1 or sampling MPC generally.
frozen_previous.stop: No more T1/T1R contact debounce, load-duration, swing-feedforward or force-projection modifications.

upstream.source_status: Relevant code paths and settings have been read; this project has not built or run the author controller yet.

execution.preserve_existing_environment: work/envs/pympc and every historical upstream snapshot remain unchanged.
execution.build: Build the pinned author headless agent_server and Python interface with its pinned dependencies. Use an isolated build directory; do not substitute latest MuJoCo or modify system/base packages. Turn off MJPC_BUILD_TESTS, PYMJPC_BUILD_TESTS and MJPC_GRPC_BUILD_TESTS where exposed by that pinned build. Fix actual build errors needed for the requested run; do not add import/smoke/unit tests or a compatibility framework.
execution.control_loop: Use official Agent(task_id='Quadruped Flat', model=model). Apply task parameters and mocap reference, synchronize actual time/qpos/qvel/act/mocap with set_state, call the original planner_step at 50Hz logical simulation time, obtain feedback-enabled get_action at 500Hz, and advance the actual model. Do not use the deployment GUI or connect SDK/ROS/hardware.
execution.feedback_action: get_action(time=data.time, nominal_action=False); hold its joint target over the original physical substeps.
execution.timing: Synchronous slow simulation is allowed: simulation time advances only by actual physical integration, not solver wall time. Record planner/feedback/physics/wall durations and explicitly label this mode. A successful offline task is not a 50Hz or 500Hz wall-time/NX claim.
execution.paper_difference: The paper describes approximately 300Hz feedback on hardware; this project adapter uses a declared 500Hz logical target update. This is not exact hardware-protocol reproduction.
execution.solver_policy: Retain the pinned author iLQG planner and its original planner_step behavior, horizon 0.35s and prediction timestep 0.01s. Record the resolved derivative/iteration/worker settings; no algorithm switching or compute-budget search.
execution.development_changes: Only evidenced task/model/input/timing mapping errors may be repaired within the allocated development starts. Do not scan gains/costs, invent another controller, or relax the physical/task constraints. Preserve every attempt.

task.original_task_source: experiments/terrain_memory/s1-contact-execution.json and the frozen s1_robot.py mission logic at 56fabe0024108fe933dd8207c3a97331b8fa6102
task.route_mapping: Reuse the original mission state machine and its smooth bounded velocity/heading references as a small task adapter. Convert them to a continuously moving body target without skipping state-based arrival/turn/return conditions. Evaluate completion and positional errors at the original body/base origin, not the author head site.
task.transition_meaning: A clock change into outbound is not proof of stable standing. Record actual phase-entry state. Retain original fall, non-foot-contact, joint-bound and timeout definitions; use corresponding actual foot/collision names on each model.
task.goal_mapping: mocap_goal = desired_body_position + Rz(desired_heading)*head_offset. For G1 read the actual fixed head-to-body offset after nonphysical site/name mapping. Do not rotate the fixed world route with the initial-yaw perturbation.
task.orientation_weight_reason: The author task default is zero; 0.03 is the fixed first implementation setting within the original XML range to give the required turn a nonzero cost. Declare this task override; no weight search.
task.heading_reference: Use the original continuous yaw-rate-limited turn reference. Do not jump Heading from 0 directly to pi: the author's sine/cosine heading residual has a stationary point at the opposite orientation.
task.initialization: Before the first set_state/physical step, explicitly apply the complete author Stand table and cost settings. current_gait starts as Stand while the XML numeric defaults are duty=0/cadence=2/amplitude=.06, so setting only the enum does not initialize a stationary gait. At each stage change set Gait plus its numeric preset before the task Transition reads cadence.
task.API_boundary: Stand/Trot are Gait values, not task modes. Do not enter Walk mode; its internal trajectory overwrites the external goal. Keep Orientation=0.03 at all phases.
task.no_short_substitute: Every physical trial starts the complete route. GUI loading, a stationary clip, mouse following, stepping in place or short contact motions do not count as task completion.

G0_author_native.role: Author Go2 physical model plus the declared original-mission task adapter. Code-reuse evidence only.
G0_author_native.physical_model: Keep task_flat.xml/go2.xml mass, inertia, passive joint dynamics, collision and native ground settings. Read and record the compiled native physics timestep and actuator settings.
G0_author_native.actuator: The active general actuator uses gains 60/5 and joint target ranges; the commented 23.7/45.43 force limits are not active. Do not describe G0 as having the project's torque limits.
G0_author_native.scope: Complete original route and stop under author physical conditions, with the declared task overrides. Not a fair same-robot performance comparison against historical B1 and not full-paper reproduction.

G1_project_limits.role: Same author controller and declared task adapter under this repository's original physical robot and limits.
G1_project_limits.model_reference: Use the original Go2 MJCF/assets retained on the execution host and fingerprinted in the fourth-round source/model bundle. The per-attempt resolved file is results/terrain_memory/simulation/tm-s1-contact-execution-20261026/development-v1-seed4/rigid-T1R-resolved.json.
preserve_physics: joint names and physical joint ranges
actuator gear relationship and original torque limits
initial qpos/qvel except the declared yaw condition
original native rigid floor and contact solref/solimp/margin
G1_project_limits.permitted_model_adaptation: Add non-colliding task sites/sensors/name maps needed by the author task and replace the control input representation with explicit joint targets/PD while preserving the original physical dynamics and torque bounds. Do not copy the author robot's inertial/passive/contact settings.
G1_project_limits.joint_target_limits: Use the original per-joint physical position ranges, mapped by name; enforce the same target bound in planner and plant.
G1_project_limits.actuator_mapping: tau = limit_original(kp*(q_target-q)-kd*qvel) with the original actuator gear/unit relationship. Enforce identical target and actuator force/torque limits inside the planner model and actual model; do not add a separate post-planning PD or unmatched clipping. Record compiled forcelimited/forcerange/gear, actual final torques and saturation.
G1_project_limits.numerical_scope: Planner prediction timestep remains the declared author 0.01s; actual integration remains 0.0002s. Record this approximation rather than claiming identical integration or changing the plant to help the solver.

phase_A.initial_condition: nominal yaw=0, author home physical state
phase_A.pass: At least one complete out-turn-return-terminal-stand task under the declared author-model setup.
phase_A.stop: If no complete mission within two starts, publish actual failure/build limitation and do not run G1 or start a different platform.

phase_B_development.initial_condition: nominal yaw=0 and original project home state
phase_B_development.pass: At least one complete nominal mission under a version/configuration that can be frozen for the formal three conditions.
phase_B_development.stop: Without a complete project-physics nominal mission, publish the scope and do not relax model/torque/task limits or start soft terrain.

phase_B_formal.initial_condition_rule: Change only the original initial root yaw quaternion. Keep body x/y, joint pose, zero velocities, fixed world route and desired heading unchanged. These are prescribed physical initial errors, not three independent random repetitions.
phase_B_formal.freeze: One version and fixed solver/task/PD/model settings across all three conditions. Reuse identical earlier records, including failures, without cherry-picking. If a new code change becomes necessary, end this round with the actual incomplete scope.
phase_B_formal.usable_baseline: All 3 conditions complete the full task within original limits; this establishes only this bounded rigid-ground execution coverage, not unknown-terrain robustness or statistical success probability.

historical_reference.use: Link existing result/version/video only. No new B1 episodes. Do not compare G0 against B1 as same-model gain, or pair deterministic iLQG conditions with old sampler seeds.
historical_reference.old_source_warning: Current main's nonadaptive sampler expects contact and alpha rows. Any future old-B1 rerun must restore its full frozen source/upstream patch, not select --controller B1 on the current patched path.

budget.reuse: Exact-version/configuration/initial-condition development episodes reused formally are one start and one result; do not repeat them to manufacture independent samples.
budget.counting: Count every actual complete-mission physical start, including early failure, lost output and superseded attempts. Build-only work does not count as a mission. A cap is not a quota; unused stage allowances cannot be transferred to another matrix or algorithm.

scientific_boundary.current_claim: Evaluate whether one established whole-body Go2 execution basis can complete the original task under declared real model/actuator constraints.
not_yet_claimed: persistent material state inside iLQG derivatives
scientific_boundary.next_material_work: Only after actual G1 complete-mission evidence, specify how continuous material state is represented in every candidate and finite-difference perturbation. The current author state nq+nv+na and derivative state 2nv+na do not include arbitrary userdata history. No Python external-force callback or global mutable state is accepted as completed memory-state integration.
scientific_boundary.later_information_comparison: A deployable material-history method still needs same-information classical-model/estimator, history-network and planning/RL comparisons. A controller swap does not establish those contributions.
scientific_boundary.latest_paper: TM22 Open-DiffLoco: retain its distinction between value fit and value-gradient/closed-loop quality for later terminal-value research. Do not relabel JAVE as this project's innovation, use its implicit disturbance terrain as material memory, or start new SHAC/PPO training now.

required: declared task and nonphysical site/name adaptations
all actual starts with phase, outcome and original completion errors
planner, feedback, physics and wall timing
one run index with exact commands and unexecuted stages
outputs.result_scope: Success requires the actual original mission completion condition. Preserve all failures; failure duration/work is not a speed/energy gain. Mechanical work is not battery energy.
outputs.publication: Commit source/configuration/compact results/figures; upload only new large arrays and complete videos from the execution host to GitHub Release. Reference existing evidence without repackaging.

delivery.end_after: Confirm commit and needed Release assets with size/digest, then end. Do not download, copy, mirror, compress or archive results again on the user's computer.
delivery.retain: Normal execution outputs, needed checkpoints and all historical evidence remain on their existing execution locations.
